questions.question: Who wrote the novel Jurassic Park?
questions.note: The 1993 Spielberg film followed; Crichton also created the TV series ER.

questions.question: The Shawshank Redemption is based on a novella by which author?
questions.note: The novella is Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption.

questions.question: Who wrote the novel Gone Girl, filmed in 2014 with Ben Affleck and Rosamund Pike?
questions.note: David Fincher directed the film; “Amazing Amy” is the fake diary.

questions.question: What is the title of the seventh and final Harry Potter novel?
questions.answer: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
choices: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
questions.note: The film split it in two, in 2010 and 2011.

questions.question: Which J. R. R. Tolkien work did Peter Jackson adapt into a trilogy released in 2001–2003?
questions.note: The Hobbit trilogy came later, in the 2010s.

questions.question: Who wrote the novel Fight Club, filmed by David Fincher in 1999?
questions.note: The first rule of Fight Club is you do not talk about Fight Club.

questions.question: Who wrote the Twilight novels, later a five-film saga?
questions.note: Bella, Edward, and Jacob; the first film arrived in 2008.

questions.question: Who wrote The Hunger Games novels?
questions.note: Katniss Everdeen; four films from 2012 to 2015, plus later prequels.

questions.question: The Devil Wears Prada (2006) is set at a fashion magazine inspired by which real publication?
questions.note: Meryl Streep’s Miranda Priestly is widely compared to Anna Wintour.

questions.question: Who wrote the novel The Da Vinci Code, filmed in 2006 with Tom Hanks?
questions.note: Ron Howard directed; Audrey Tautou and Ian McKellen co-starred.
